anchor: Which weapon gives +3 to hit and damage and lets me spend up to three of its uses on a hit for extra pushing harm?
My magical pole just ran out of uses. What happens if I roll a 1 on a d20, and when does it recharge?
Which undead servant's dagger leaves a victim frozen in place for an hour if the blow drops them to zero hit points?
Which undead creature can share its senses with its maker and rush away or step back as a quick extra move on its turn?
Which pointed wizard's headgear lets me attempt an incantation I never learned, spending a slot and making a magical-lore check against 10 plus its level?
Is there headwear for wizards that channels my magic, and do I have to reach inside it to pull each effect out?
As a level 5 sorcerer, how many level-three magic slots do I get, and how many minor tricks do I know?
At sorcerer level 6, how many prepared effects can I have ready, and how big is my pool of internal magical energy?
Which monster can take a quick action to turn into a Small pig-like beast while keeping all its own statistics?
If a monster turns into a Medium mix of animal and person, does what it wears change too, and do its abilities stay the same?
Which transformation lets me sprout gills and swim as fast as I walk, or grow claws or horns, lasting up to an hour while I maintain focus?
Is there a second-level magic that lets me look like a different species but not a different size, while keeping my stats?
Which finger band holds a crushing water-wave effect costing five uses and an icy storm costing two?
Which jewelry offers a lightning effect that chains between foes for three uses, plus a wind barrier for one use?
What barbarian levels let me take a special talent or raise my attributes, starting at level four and repeating at eight, twelve, and sixteen?
If I'm a barbarian at level four, can I swap the usual stat bump for a different talent I qualify for?
Which large cat can leap 25 feet after a ten-foot running start and scare a creature within 15 feet with a bellow?
Can a large beast get an edge on attacks against a target when a companion within five feet of that target is still conscious?
Is there a necklace that lets me travel to a familiar spot in another reality by passing a scholarly magic check against DC 15?
Which pendant sends me and everything within 15 feet to a random destination on a d100 roll after a failed scholarly check?
When my holy magic mends a companion's wounds using a slot, how much of that restoration comes back to me as a cleric at level six?
Which third-level deception conjures a lifelike fake creature or object up to 20 feet across, moved at range for up to ten minutes while I keep my focus?
How can a viewer tell a lifelike phantom is false if they study it and pass a deduction check against my magic DC?
What quick action lets me step away from foes without them getting free swings at me for the rest of my turn?
Which large undead creature with horns can knock me flat with an extra stabbing horn strike after charging at least twenty feet toward me?
What undead creature shrugs off toxins and fatigue, yet takes extra harm from blunt blows?
I'm about to dive into a lake and need to scale a cliff afterward; is there an uncommon hand-worn item that helps with both?
Which undead spirit can pass through creatures and walls, but takes pushing harm if it ends its turn inside a solid object?
What undead creature is weakened by bright sunlight, and whose attack drains a victim's maximum health?
Which massive beast with a strength score of 21 and poor agility can knock me flat with a horn after running at least 20 feet at me?
What clumsy, dim-witted hulking animal has armor class 13 and a horn attack that hits for about 14 damage?
Is there a piece of jewelry that makes my descents slow to sixty feet per round so I take no harm from landing?
What first-level magic sends a 15-foot fan of flame from me, halving the 3d6 harm for anyone who nimbly dodges?
Which fiery area attack ignites loose paper, wood or cloth in its path, and grows by 1d6 for each higher slot used?
What magic lets me delicately work objects at a distance, like opening a door, pouring from a vial, or taking something out of a bag?
What kitchen set lets me prepare trail food and check whether a meal is tainted, against a difficulty of 15?
Is there a one-gold-piece food kit that makes meals tastier on a difficulty-10 check, and weighs eight pounds?
If I uncork a magic fire-genie vessel and roll a 1 on a d10, does the creature fight me, and for how long?
How many openings can a fire-genie jar take before its captive escapes on the fourth, and does its stopper stay locked for a day each time?
Is there a second-level magic that turns a cord into a hidden pocket space for up to eight medium creatures, reachable by climbing it?
Inside a concealed chamber I've made, can outside arrows or magic reach us, and what happens to everyone when the effect ends?
Which cursed chopping weapon adds +1 and extra hit points per level, but makes me go wild unless I pass a DC 15 wisdom roll when hurt?
Once bound to a melee weapon, what keeps it within my reach and penalizes my swings with other weapons?
What second-level magic lets a willing ally spew a 15-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison for up to a minute?
Is there a magic that grows its blast by 1d6 per higher slot and deals 3d6 of a chosen element, halved on a successful nimble roll?
Which creature that changes into animal form curses humanoids with its bite, so a victim who drops to zero turns into its kind?
What shapeshifter has 120 hit points, runs 40 feet in animal shape, and can creep silently in as a quick extra move?
Which zealot humanoid deals extra life-draining harm with its blade and can freeze a victim in place once per day?
Can a robed humanoid conjure a floating weapon as a quick extra move twice a day, and shine light or perform tricks at will?
What small mischievous creature with 15 armor class can take a quick extra move to slip away by stepping back or hiding?
Can a 10-hit-point fey creature add 1d4 damage to its scimitar and shortbow strikes when it has an edge on the roll?
If I'm knocked flat, can I only crawl or pay half my speed to stand, and can I stand at all with zero speed?
When I'm lying on the ground, do adjacent foes swing with an edge, distant ones with a penalty, and do I swing at a penalty too?
Which tiny heavenly creature has an edge on resisting magic and can add 2 to a nearby creature's check or resistance roll twice a day?
What winged guardian with 24 hit points adds 2d6 holy-light damage to its claw strikes and resists mind-based attacks?
Can a striped predator take a Large hybrid of cat and person or a Large full cat form, and still keep the same stats?
How much life can I return to a touched friend with a first-level touch, plus my magic-ability modifier, and does it grow with bigger slots?
Which first-level abjuration, castable by bards, clerics, druids, paladins, and rangers, works on a touched creature?
Which warrior tradition thrills in battle's chaos and channels its wild anger into violence rather than other goals?
What third-level divination lets me beam a short text of up to 25 words into a known creature's mind across any distance, even to other realms?
If I psychically message someone across worlds, what is the percentage chance it never arrives, and can the target refuse me afterward for eight hours?
If I hurl my wooden pole and it turns into a giant serpent I control mentally, what happens to the pole if the serpent is killed?
Which wooden rod turns into a serpent that acts right after me in the turn order and obeys mental orders within 60 feet?
What cleric power lets me aim my religious emblem at a creature within 30 feet to mend it or inflict holy-light or life-draining harm on a failed constitution roll?
How many times between rests can I tap holy energy from the outer planes, and how many come back after a short rest?
Which barrier of rock-like material has armor class 15 and 30 hit points per inch of thickness, and gets immunity to toxins and mental-harm?
If I hold my focus for the entire time, does my conjured earthen partition become permanent and immune to being unmade by magic?
Which eighth-level magic shakes a 100-foot circle into rough ground, knocking creatures flat and breaking their focus if they fail a nimble roll?
Can a magic tremor crack open 1d6 chasms of up to 100 feet deep and deal 50 crushing damage to buildings each turn?
Which fourth-level enchantment strips creatures in a 10-foot-radius ball of their quick extra moves and instant responses, and makes them roll a d10 each turn?
Can an enemy that fails a wisdom roll be forced to wander in a random compass direction or swing at whoever is next to it?
Which epic-tier option, for characters at level 19 or higher, raises an ability by one up to 30 and grants truly-seeing within 60 feet?
